verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
O God you search me
And you know me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: All my thoughts lie open to your gaze

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
When I walk or lie down
You are before me

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines: Ever the maker and keeper of my days

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You know my resting and my rising
You discern my purpose form afar

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
And with love everlasting
You besiege me

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
In every moment of life or death
You are

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines: Before a word is on my tongue Lord

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines: You have known its meaning through and through

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines: You are with me beyond my understanding

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines: God of my present, my past and future too

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
Although Your spirit is upon me
Still I search for shelter from Your light

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
There is nowhere on earth
I can escape You

verse.name: v4c
verse.lines:
Even the darkness is
Radiant in Your sight

verse.name: v5a
verse.lines:
For you created me and shaped me
Give me life within my mother's womb

verse.name: v5b
verse.lines:
For the wonder of who I am
I prasie You

verse.name: v5c
verse.lines: Safe in Your hands all creation is made new
